notes:

- No standard transitive pair

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:

- {出席|しゅっせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take attendance
- {出席|しゅっせき}{率|りつ}: attendance rate
- {出席|しゅっせき}{者|しゃ}: attendee
